title: Maximum OR of Array with K Shifts

monster.name: Bit Shift Titan
monster.title: Multiplier of Binary Values
monster.defeatQuote: Maximum bitwise OR achieved by shifting one element left by k bits!

description: You are given a 0-indexed integer array `nums` of length `n` and an integer `k`. In an operation, you can multiply any `nums[i]` by 2. Return the maximum possible value of `nums[0] | nums[1] | ... | nums[n - 1]` that can be obtained after applying the operation at most `k` times.
starterCode:
def maximumOr(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def maximumOr(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    n = len(nums)
    pref = [0] * (n + 1)
    suff = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n): pref[i + 1] = pref[i] | nums[i]
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1): suff[i] = suff[i + 1] | nums[i]
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        ans = max(ans, pref[i] | (nums[i] << k) | suff[i + 1])
    return ans
hints: Greedy property: all k multiplications by 2 (left shifts) should be applied to the same single number.
